text.en: Waking before dawn in the cold month of Margazhi has been a Tamil tradition for ages.

This lesson says that our ancestors lived in harmony with nature and divided life into landscapes (திணை). They rose early, worshipped God and began their day with prayer. In the month of Margazhi they observed vows (நோன்பு) and sang to God.
The festival shows how Tamil culture links nature, devotion and community. Songs like Thiruppavai and Thiruvempavai are sung in this month.
Terms: மார்கழி (the Tamil month Dec-Jan), நோன்பு (vow), இறைவழிபாடு (worship) and பண்பாடு (culture).
